folklore.title: Folklore
folklore.descriptionHtml: Rooted in Kati's earliest work — folk motifs, handwoven references, references to old-world textiles rendered in her unmistakable hand.

whimsy.title: Whimsy
whimsy.descriptionHtml: Inspiration drawn from fresh fruit on her table and advertisements in the latest women's fashion magazines to bouquets of freshly cut wildflowers in a vase.
